Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.layer

Class Layer

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.layer.Layer
public class Layer extends Object
DTO for layer details.

Maps the response body of GET /rest/layers/{layerName} or GET /rest/workspaces/{ws}/layers/{layerName}.

Verified against GeoServer 2.28.2.

  • Layers are created automatically when a Coverage or FeatureType is POSTed with configure=first — there is no REST POST endpoint for layers directly.
  • enabled and advertised can be changed via PUT but are not included in GET responses.
  • attribution is always present (returns only logoWidth=0, logoHeight=0 when empty).
  • styles: if omitted on PUT, existing styles are preserved (unlike authorityURLs/identifiers).
  • authorityURLs and identifiers: if omitted on PUT, existing values are deleted (full replace).
